Form validator

Source: R/v2-validate.R
shad_validator.Rd

A server-side validator that pushes shadcn-styled errors into the shad_form_field() wrapping each control (via update_shad_form_field()), with optional submit-button gating and an error summary. API shape mirrors shinyvalidate; implemented natively with no extra dependencies.

Usage

shad_validator(session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain())

Arguments

session

The Shiny session.

Value

A validator object (list of functions).

Details

The returned object's methods:

add_rule(inputId, rule, ...)

Register a rule (chainable). Multiple rules per field run in order; the first failure wins.

enable() / disable()

Start / stop live validation (errors show on change once enabled; disable() clears them).

is_valid()

Reactive-context logical: all rules currently pass.

validate()

Imperative full pass; shows every error and returns a logical (use in submit handlers).

fields()

Registered input ids.

bind_submit(buttonId)

Disable a shad_button() while invalid.

bind_summary(id)

Render a shad_form_summary() on validate/enable.

See also

Other shadshiny forms: shad_form_counter(), shad_form_message(), shad_form_summary(), shad_rules, update_shad_form_field()

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    sv <- shad_validator()
    sv$add_rule("email", shad_rule_required())
    sv$add_rule("email", shad_rule_email())
    sv$enable()
    observeEvent(input$submit, if (sv$validate()) message("ok"))
  }
}
